purpose: Construct a complete Reference-only self-disagreement calibration dataset for the thirty F-ROSS13 extension materials before any new RossFast discrepancy execution.

scope.temporal_construction: one Reference solve over 0.0064 day versus two sequential Reference solves over 0.0032 + 0.0032 day

validity: coarse, half1 and half2 return SW_SOLVE_CONVERGED on route legacy-reference-bound
typed integrated mass residual is available, finite and <= 1e-12 cm for all three solves
native balance-rate residual is available and finite for all three solves
all endpoint pressure-head and water-content values are finite and inside the declared E0 physical domain
coarse and refined endpoint shapes represent the same final physical time

outcome_rule.complete: All 180 Reference pairs valid. Emit all self-disagreement metrics. Do not yet authorize RossFast.
outcome_rule.blocked: Any invalid Reference pair makes the extension calibration domain incomplete. Retain every failure and stop before RossFast extension execution.
outcome_rule.no_repair: Do not search a different timestep, drop a material or relax a numerical tolerance inside P2E11 after observing failure.

next_if_complete: Create a separate Reference-only threshold-freeze workunit using per-Se maxima over all 60 valid cases in each Se stratum. Only after that freeze may a 180-case Reference-versus-RossFast extension matrix be preregistered.
